name: Arasaka
text: The oldest living zaibatsu. Arasaka sells the guns, the banks, the bodyguards, and the afterlife. Saburo Arasaka built an empire that treats Night City as a branch office with a body count. The Tower in City Center is a black blade in the sky: counterintel, Soulkiller research, and enough private military to start a war without asking Tokyo. They lost the Fourth Corporate War on paper. They did not lose the city. If a contract has a red sun on it, read the fine print twice and assume the Relic is already in someone's head.

name: Biotechnica
focus: Biotech, synthetic food, pharmaceuticals, CHOOH2 feedstock
text: They invented the plant that became gasoline and a grocery list that never saw a cow. Biotechnica's labs print meat, drugs, and the enzymes Petrochem cannot live without. Their Night City campus smells like a greenhouse and a crime scene. Ethics review is a brochure. If it grows in a vat and ends up in a body, Biotechnica has a patent and a lawyer.

name: Constitutional Arms
hq: Texas · Night City warehouse, Santo Domingo
text: The other American gun, the one without a senator. Constitutional Arms sells loud, simple, and in bulk. Budget cousins live in every stash. Militech hates them for the discount; gangs love them for the same reason. If the rifle is ugly and it still works after a dumpster, it is probably Constitutional.

name: IEC
hq: Night City · grid campuses, Santo Domingo
text: International Electric Corporation. They sell the grid that Night Corp pretends to manage and the transformers that keep Watson angry. IEC is the corp you forget until the lights die. Their linemen are union, armed, and tired. If a district brownouts on purpose, IEC sent the invoice first.

name: Kang Tao
text: The smartgun house. Kang Tao does not sell you a rifle so much as a conversation between the gun and your optics. Chinese state-adjacent, ruthless about patents, and everywhere a Solo wants a weapon that aims itself. Their Night City presence is smaller than Arasaka's and meaner in the showroom. If the bullet turns the corner, Kang Tao wrote the corner.

name: Kendachi
focus: Monoedge blades, personal melee, status steel
text: The sword company that never left 1600 and never missed a fiscal year. Kendachi mono-katana are a religion in Japantown and a felony in the Glen. Each blade is a serial number, a waiting list, and a eulogy waiting to happen. Solos carry them to be seen. Corps buy them to be feared.

name: Kiroshi Opticals
hq: Osaka · Night City clinic row, Japantown
text: The eyes of Night City. Kiroshi sells the optics that make Kang Tao smartguns polite and ripperdocs rich. Their clinics are cleaner than Trauma Team's and twice as expensive to leave. Scan, zoom, night, targeting, a HUD that never blinks unless you pay for the blink. If someone is looking at you and you can tell, they are Kiroshi.

name: Militech
hq: Washington, NUSA · Night City campus, Santo Domingo
focus: Weapons, armor, private military, NUSA contracts
text: America's favorite gun. Militech arms the NUSA, half the world's police, and anyone who can pay in eddies and patriotism. They are Arasaka's oldest enemy and Night City's loudest landlord of violence. Fourth Corporate War leftovers still sit in Santo Domingo warehouses. Their sales pitch is freedom; their invoice is a tank. If you see olive drab chrome and a stars-and-stripes stencil, you are looking at a Militech problem that thinks it is a solution.

name: NetWatch
hq: Classified · Night City blacksite, City Center
text: The cops of the old Net. NetWatch holds the Blackwall, the last fence between the human Net and whatever the RABIDS left behind. They license decks, burn illegal ICE, and disappear netrunners who dig too deep. Their public face is a helpdesk. Their real face is a raid. If a daemon smiles at you in the architecture, it is probably NetWatch, or it is something NetWatch failed to kill.

name: Night Corp
focus: Infrastructure, transit, civic contracts, rumored AI
text: The company that built the city and never left the blueprints. Night Corp runs water, maglev, waste, and a lot of things the Council pretends are public. Richard Night founded it; what runs it now is a board that does not like cameras. Street rumor puts a sealed AI in the basement and a mayor in its pocket. Officially they are a civic contractor. Unofficially, if the lights stay on, Night Corp allowed it.

name: Orbital Air
hq: Low Earth orbit · Night City spaceport, Badlands
text: They own the way up. Orbital Air runs the shuttles, the stations, and the hotels where corpos go to pretend gravity is optional. Night City's spaceport is a Petrochem neighbor and a smuggler's dream. Tickets cost a lifetime. Cargo costs a war. If you need to leave the planet, you fly Orbital or you do not fly.

name: Petrochem
hq: Dallas · Night City refinery belt, Badlands edge
text: They grow the fuel that moves the city. Petrochem's CHOOH2 is in every tank that still has a tank. They own fields, refineries, and a feud with SovOil that has killed more sailors than weather. Biotechnica supplies the biotech; Petrochem supplies the volume. If your AV smells like corn and violence, that is Petrochem.

name: SovOil
hq: Moscow · Night City tanker terminal, Megadocks
text: The other fuel. SovOil never forgave Petrochem for CHOOH2 and never stopped sending tankers into Night City water. Old oil, new grudges, a fleet that treats the Pacific like a parking lot. Their dockside offices smell like rust and diplomacy. If a shoreline moves overnight, check which flag was on the spill.

name: Trauma Team
text: The ambulance that shoots back. Trauma Team sells gold, silver, and executive cards: an AV, a trauma team, and a bill that lands before you do. They will pull you out of a firefight if your chip is current. They will step over you if it is not. White armor, red cross, guns out. The most honest corp in Night City, because they tell you the price of living up front.

name: Tsunami Defense
focus: Heavy weapons, vehicle guns, naval systems
text: Japanese steel for problems that smartguns cannot solve. Tsunami Defense builds the cannons that go on boats, AVs, and bad ideas. Smaller than Kang Tao, meaner in a siege. Arasaka uses them when a contract needs to look like weather. If the round is the size of a fist, it is Tsunami.

name: Zetatech
text: The house brand of chrome that is not quite Arasaka and not quite Militech. Zetatech builds cars, cyberlimbs, and the cheap decks that get people killed. Reliable enough for street docs, ambitious enough to want a tower. Their ads promise upgrade paths. Their warranties expire when you do.
